networks.description: Turn a lecture into a slide deck. Upload or record audio, or paste a transcript, and the agents build, check and export the slides.
networks.name: deckcast
sample_queries: What are the key points of this lecture?
Build me a deck from the transcript, no more than 8 slides.
Check the slides against the transcript and fix anything that is not in it.

peer_policy.note: Version 0.1 uses local specialists and page-local actions only. No peer networks are called.
